derivation: from the same root as H8558 (תָּמָר);
def: an erection, i.e. pillar (probably for a guide-board)

occurrences.text: Set thee up waymarks, make thee high heaps: set thine heart toward the highway, even the way which thou wentest: turn again, O virgin of Israel, turn again to these thy cities.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
